production_write_gates.effect: production deployment was authorized after proof; production write lanes still require their own private authorization manifests

interpretation: A configured address, provider variable, source hash, or private file is not authorization by itself.
Missing private provider manifests block only their dependent lanes.
The fresh W13-104 production backup/restore proof passed before production runtime deployment.
Production signup submit, CRM import apply, email send, Stripe TEST, provider canary, Buffer publication, DNS, or protected diagnostics require their lane-specific inputs.
